text:
𝗔𝗥𝗬𝗔 𝟭𝟴𝟭 𝗢𝗙𝗙 𝟲𝟴! 🔥

Priyansh Arya smashed 19 sixes as Delhi made 275/5 v Tamil Nadu in SMAT.
Delhi won by 116 runs.

What an innings! 👇
#Cricket #SMAT

facebook.caption:
𝗣𝗥𝗜𝗬𝗔𝗡𝗦𝗛 𝗔𝗥𝗬𝗔 𝗞𝗔 𝗧𝗢𝗢𝗙𝗔𝗡! 🔥🏏

👉 Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy mein Delhi ne Tamil Nadu ko 116 run se haraya
👉 Arya ke 181 run sirf 68 gend par, 19 chhakke
👉 Delhi ka score 275/5, Tamil Nadu 159 par all out
👉 Digvesh Singh ke 4/37

Is innings ko aap kitne mein rate karoge? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #SMAT #DelhiCricket
